verdict.rationale: Morph is an OpenAI-compatible inference API, so asking whether it serves embeddings and reranking is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents only chat completions, Messages, Fast Apply, Compact, Reflexes classifiers, batch, caching and dedicated endpoints. No embeddings or rerank endpoint appears anywhere; WarpGrep semantic code search and the Reflex classifiers are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
